name: posterpilot
description: PosterPilot is a self-hosted artwork manager for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby. Browse your library, find covers across MediUX, Fanart.tv, TMDB and ThePosterDB, and apply them directly to your media server and/or by exporting Kometa/PMM-compatible YAML. Credentials can be set here or in the in-app Settings page (including Plex login). Point the /kometa volume at your existing Kometa config to have exported YAML picked up on its next run.

paths.name: App data (/data)
paths.description: Persistent SQLite database, settings, history and the rotating log file (/data/logs). Keep this on a mounted volume so state survives updates; no extra log volume is needed.

paths.name: Kometa assets (/kometa)
paths.description: Optional. Mount your existing Kometa assets/config directory so exported YAML lands where Kometa reads it. Leave default if you do not use Kometa.

paths.name: Kometa config dir (/kometa-config)
paths.description: Optional. To let PosterPilot manage Kometa's OWN config.yml (the dedicated /kometa manager page), mount Kometa's config directory here (read/write), then set 'Kometa config path' below to e.g. /kometa-config/config.yml. PosterPilot co-locates its type-safe movie/show metadata files in this directory. Leave empty if unused.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the PosterPilot web UI.

variables.name: Server type
variables.description: Which media server to manage: plex, jellyfin, or emby. Default plex.

variables.name: TMDB key
variables.description: TMDB v3 API key or v4 bearer/JWT (auto-detected). Required for metadata + TMDB artwork. Or set it in Settings.

variables.name: Plex URL
variables.description: e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400 — or use the in-app Plex login / connection discovery.

variables.name: Plex token
variables.description: Your X-Plex-Token. Leave blank to acquire it via the in-app Plex login.

variables.name: Jellyfin URL
variables.description: Jellyfin base URL (when Server type = jellyfin).

variables.name: Jellyfin API key
variables.description: Jellyfin API key (when Server type = jellyfin).

variables.name: Emby URL
variables.description: Emby base URL (when Server type = emby).

variables.name: Emby API key
variables.description: Emby API key (when Server type = emby).

variables.name: Fanart.tv key
variables.description: Fanart.tv personal API key — enables the Fanart.tv artwork provider.

variables.name: Kometa config path
variables.description: Optional. Path INSIDE the container to Kometa's own config.yml to manage (e.g. /kometa-config/config.yml). Empty = Kometa manager off. Mount the dir via 'Kometa config dir' above.

variables.name: Kometa config mode
variables.description: merge (default, surgical — preserves your other keys and comments) or own (PosterPilot regenerates and fully owns config.yml). Empty = merge.

variables.name: Kometa metadata reference prefix
variables.description: Relative directory Kometa sees at runtime for PosterPilot's split metadata files. Default config; use . for bare filenames. This is not a host filesystem path.

variables.name: UI language
variables.description: UI locale: en (default), es, zh, ja, or pt-BR.

variables.name: Log directory
variables.description: Folder for the rotating log file (posterpilot.log). Default /data/logs — already inside the /data volume, so no extra mount is needed.

variables.name: Event retention
variables.description: Max number of activity-log rows kept in the database; older rows are pruned. Default 2000.

variables.name: Port (internal)
variables.description: Internal listen port. Leave at 3000 unless you know what you are doing.
